conditions: Still-image routes use Gemini text prompting when needed, then render through the FLUX local service.
image_generation.prompt_policy: Grounded social-systems illustration with readable rooms, paperwork, tools, and no visible text or watermark.
image_generation.default_prompt_template: {domain_label}. Create one polished still image of {image_subject} for {actor_name} and {target_name}. Emphasize lived-in civic interiors, notices, ledgers, and social coordination pressure. No visible text, no watermark.

inventory_generation.policy: Generate compact role-appropriate actionable inventory only from the item catalog. Use property_library for non-actionable treasures, titles, clues, personal tools, debts, or keepsakes. Do not create images here; image generation is a later system step when a route requests it.
inventory_generation.reason: Boutique character node already generated at least eight validated inventory items per agent.

functions.purpose: Create or advance event threads for the Litigation Cycle loop so the world keeps generating concrete next steps in The High Court of Ticks, Evidence Vault.
functions.event_policy: Prefer compact progress events that deepen Litigation Cycle: Players gather evidence of temporal malpractice, present cases to the Gear-Judges, and enforce ritualistic penalties. Use Advocate, Judge, Witness as likely responders, keep the pressure on The ticking of the Doomsday Clock., and ensure at least one event gives players a readable way into the world such as A newly appointed apprentice arriving at the gates..

functions.event_policy: Use the compiled conflict hooks as style anchors only when they fit current world memory: The Great Gear has skipped a beat, causing a temporal paradox in the lower wards.; A rival conservatory has filed a lawsuit claiming ownership of the Rain-Dance ritual.; The Lead Chronometer has been found frozen in time, and the primary suspect is their successor.. Prefer incidents that create follow-up routes, targetable bottlenecks, or contested interpretations instead of one-off flavor.

functions.purpose: Generate newcomer-readable incidents that expose what the world is about and give human players an immediate way to participate.
functions.event_policy: Prefer events that make the world legible from the ground level: A newly appointed apprentice arriving at the gates.; A disgraced lawyer seeking redemption in the clockwork courts.; A merchant delivering rare oils for the Great Gear.. A good event should tell a player where to go, who to ask, or which pressure is already live.
